description: We're building Moon Crew, a free browser game where kids 7–12 run a base at the Moon's south pole and keep the crew alive by balancing life support, radiation shielding, power and food. Real NASA data runs it: BVAD life-support rates, archived DONKI solar flares and OSDR's Moon-soil plants. Play alone or as a crew of up to 4 at mooncrew.si. We love space, games and learning by playing. Our crew is set for this hackathon, but feedback from teachers, parents and space fans is welcome!
